name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
organizer: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)

signal_justification.award_size: Offers substantial seed capital of up to ₹50 Lakhs.
signal_justification.eligibility_fit: Requires DPIIT recognition and MVP stage, which Vybora may qualify for depending on incorporation status.
signal_justification.effort_inverse: Application requires documentation and official government verification processes.
signal_justification.strategic_value: Provides non-dilutive/seed support and high validation for Indian startups.
signal_justification.deadline_urgency: The deadline is December 31, 2026, leaving ample time to apply.

signal_justification.eligibility_fit: Open globally to early-stage startups regardless of domain.
signal_justification.effort_inverse: Requires multi-step application including videos, demo, and detailed pitch deck.
signal_justification.strategic_value: Offers global investor network, prestige, and top-tier accelerator support.
signal_justification.deadline_urgency: Deadline is September 30, 2026, which is far in the future.

name: NITI Aayog Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) Grant

signal_justification.award_size: Provides a financial grant of ₹25 Lakhs.
signal_justification.eligibility_fit: Requires at least 51% equity owned by female founder(s), which may not match Vybora's ownership.
signal_justification.effort_inverse: Standard government grant application effort required.
signal_justification.strategic_value: Provides mentorship and enterprise acceleration within India.
